newsitem.title: UK: UK's SIB reviews pension rates of return formulas.
newsitem.headline: UK's SIB reviews pension rates of return formulas.

text.p: Britain's Securities and Investments Board (SIB) has announced an adjustment to the rates of return to be used for calculating actual and prospective loss and redress for pension transfers and opt outs.
The periodic review of the calculations was introduced after a scandal over mis-selling of pensions two years ago.

The detailed calculations are available from SIB offices. Those for loss and redress will apply from November 1, 1996 to January 31, 1997, and the changes for actual loss calculation will apply from November 1 1996 until further notice.
